Tara (marketing): Heads-up: OSS RefKit mini-launch happened 07:30 PT. Quick idea: follow with a short technical webinar + gated benchmark appendix to capture more engineering leads.
Miles (devrel): Nice. Got first-hour metrics?
Tara (marketing): ~2.4k pageviews in 12h, 160 newsletter signups, 4 demo requests, 22 repo forks.
Cleo (growth): Demo requests origin? company sizes?
Noah (content): 3 startups, 1 mid-market. Most signups from inline CTA.
lead-bot: 2 leads missing "source_medium" -> parked in manual-review queue.
Ada (ops): Can default missing source_medium to "organic" and tag 'auto-defaulted' for SDRs. Will push after smoke tests.
Miles (devrel): Also, the post shows single-request latency. We should add a bench note clarifying batch vs latency and link the appendix.
Noah (content): I'll add: "Latency measured at batch=1 on dedicated; batching increases throughput—see appendix for full configs." Also propose A/B CTAs: "Join live walkthrough" vs "Get repo + appendix".
Cleo (growth): Webinar: "RefKit in practice: deployment, benchmarks, and cost tradeoffs". Target 40-60 devs. Capture repo downloads.
Tara (marketing): Quick actions:
- Noah: update post copy + add CTA variants (EOD)
- Ada: route default + reprocess the 2 leads (today)
- Miles: draft webinar outline + confirm Rafael for runtime segment (tomorrow)
- Cleo: build reg page + promo plan ($500) (48h)
Ada (ops): Reprocessing command: python tools/reprocess_leads.py --filter missing_source_medium --assign default:organic --tag auto-defaulted
Miles (devrel): Proposed agenda: 10m intro, 20m demo, 15m benchmarks/infra, 15m Q&A. Rafael, can you take the infra section?
Rafael (runtime): Yep, will prepare slides showing config diffs for hosted vs dedicated.
Cleo (growth): A/B plan: measure CTA CTR -> reg conversion -> demo request.
Tara (marketing): Please update thread when done so SDRs can pick leads. Thanks :rocket:
